description: Real-time BART San Francisco Bay Area train departures for a station — next train departure times in minutes, per destination, with platform, direction, train length (cars), line color, delay, and bikes allowed. Station accepts a 4-letter BART code ("EMBR", "SFIA") or a station name ("Embarcadero", "Downtown Berkeley", "SFO"). Answers "when is the next BART train". Example: bart_departures({ station: "Embarcadero" })

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own BART API key (defaults to the BART public key)

station.description: BART station — 4-letter code like "EMBR", "MONT", "SFIA", or a name like "Embarcadero", "Powell", "Downtown Berkeley"

name: bart_departures
title: Bart Departures
